title: Better
tagline: Let your ecosystem improve your dApp.
description:
We built an easy-to-fork platform allowing dApps to improve their products by coordinating users, developers and funders to each contribute their resources to the project.

1. Users give feedback and vote on feature ideas
2. Funders fund features
3. Developers implement the features and get rewarded

This allows dApps to scale their growth, while minimizing coordination work.
how_its_made:
- We are querying github issues through the github API

- A static nextjs site, that lists the issues automatically whenever modified. Projects that fork our repo also fork this site and can host it as their own subpage, eg. better.dapp.com

- Ethereum smart contracts for escrow, taking interest-bearing tokens

- Users can fund into the escrow via ethers.js on our static page

- TheGraph helps us to track funding pools
